gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.rationale: The presence of a somatic KDR (VEGFR2) mutation and the histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels support this diagnosis, with Angiosarcoma being a close runner-up due to the clinical presentation of a well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias

rejected.label: Cherry Angioma
rejected.why: The lesion's characteristics, although similar, do not fully align with typical cherry angioma presentations, and the absence of pain or pruritus is noted as a contradiction

rejected.label: Telangiectasia
rejected.why: While telangiectasias are present, the diagnosis is too broad and does not account for the specific genetic mutation found

rejected.label: Cutaneous Angiokeratoma
rejected.why: The clinical and histological features do not specifically support this diagnosis over the champion or runner-up
